scope: Independent focused chronology/endings and material-support spot check. Writing samples were assigned to Africa reviewer. This is not a full independent verification of all passages.
result: One chronology clarification recommended before publication; one source-provenance qualification. Checked other chronology and selected material claims are supported.

findings.location: periods[0], title and summary; overview opening
findings.issue: The period begins at imported coverage year 1000 but is titled The early kingdom, which can make readers assume kingdom status in 1000. The Aragon archives identify Ramiro's inheritance of the county in 1035 as the beginning of this monarchy. The overview also starts with a kingdom rather than the earlier county.
findings.recommendedChange: Title the 1000-1137 phase County and emerging kingdom. State that the map begins in 1000, while the monarchy developed from the county inherited by Ramiro I in 1035. Open the overview with Aragon developed from a Pyrenean county into a kingdom. Retain map-coverage bounds.
findings.sourceNote: DARA archive biography: Ramiro received county in 1035; contemporaries recognized royal power although his own documents did not use king as his title. This wording avoids the differing 1063/1064 death dates on institutional pages.

findings.issue: The Virtual Library authority page labels its historical summary as extracted from Spanish Wikipedia. Its government domain should not be treated as independently authored historical scholarship.
findings.recommendedChange: Record that provenance explicitly, and use the DARA county biography for early state formation. The 1137 pact can additionally cite the University of Zaragoza account of Darío Español's research. Existing wording about the pact laying the basis of a union is appropriately cautious.
